name: Apollo 11 Laser Ranging Retroreflector
discovery: Precise Earth–Moon distance; the Moon is drifting away about 3.8 cm a year
earth_benefit: Tests gravity theory and helps us understand tides and Earth's rotation
how_it_worked: Corner-shaped mirrors bounce laser light straight back to where it came from; needs no power
paved_the_way_for: Newer reflectors carried by recent Moon landers

name: Eagle descent stage
discovery: First samples brought back showed the Moon is ancient and was once molten
earth_benefit: Clues to how Earth and the Moon formed together
how_it_worked: Descent engine and four legs for a soft landing; then served as the launch pad for the trip home

name: Apollo 12 seismometer (ALSEP)
discovery: Recorded moonquakes and revealed the Moon's inner layers
earth_benefit: Shows how rocky worlds, including Earth, are built inside
how_it_worked: Sensitive sensors felt tiny ground tremors; a nuclear-powered generator kept it running for years

name: Apollo 15 Lunar Roving Vehicle
discovery: Let astronauts reach the 'Genesis Rock', a piece of very early lunar crust
earth_benefit: A window into the first chapter of the Earth–Moon story
how_it_worked: Folding electric car with wire-mesh wheels, unpacked from the side of the lander

name: Apollo 17 Lunar Roving Vehicle
discovery: Orange soil made of volcanic glass beads
earth_benefit: Proof the Moon once had fiery eruptions
how_it_worked: Battery-powered car that carried astronauts kilometres from the lander to reach varied geology

name: Surveyor 3
discovery: Showed the lunar surface was firm enough to land people on
earth_benefit: Made crewed landings possible; Apollo 12 later visited it and brought parts home
how_it_worked: Retro-rockets and crushable legs for a soft landing; a scoop dug trenches by remote control

name: Ranger 7
discovery: First close-up US pictures of the Moon, thousands sent before impact
earth_benefit: Helped choose safe Apollo landing sites
how_it_worked: Six TV cameras sent pictures home right up to the moment of impact
paved_the_way_for: Surveyor landers and Apollo site selection

name: Lunar Prospector
discovery: Signs of hydrogen at the poles, pointing to water ice
earth_benefit: Why Artemis is heading to the south pole
how_it_worked: Small spinning orbiter that counted neutrons coming off the surface to sense hydrogen
paved_the_way_for: LCROSS and Artemis south pole plans

name: LCROSS Centaur impactor
discovery: Confirmed water in the debris thrown up by the impact
earth_benefit: Water means drinking water, air and fuel for future crews
how_it_worked: An empty rocket stage used as a hammer; a trailing craft flew through the plume and measured it

name: Viking 1 lander
discovery: First long-running science on the Martian surface; life tests were inconclusive
earth_benefit: Shaped how we search for life ever since
how_it_worked: Nuclear-powered lander with a robotic arm that fed soil to an onboard laboratory
paved_the_way_for: Curiosity and Perseverance's search for signs of life

name: Pathfinder lander and Sojourner rover
discovery: First rover on Mars; rock chemistry hinted at a wetter past
earth_benefit: Proved small, cheaper missions can work
how_it_worked: Landed by bouncing on airbags; a microwave-sized solar rover rolled down a ramp
paved_the_way_for: Spirit, Opportunity and every rover since

name: Spirit rover
discovery: Uncovered nearly pure silica, a sign of ancient hot springs
earth_benefit: Hot springs on Earth are full of microbes
how_it_worked: Solar-powered with six wheels; a broken wheel scraped a trench that exposed the silica
paved_the_way_for: Perseverance's hunt for ancient habitable places

name: Opportunity rover
discovery: Hematite 'blueberries' and other evidence of past water
earth_benefit: Mars was once a place where water flowed
how_it_worked: Solar-powered; built for 90 days, lasted more than 14 years

name: Phoenix lander
discovery: Dug up water ice just below the surface
earth_benefit: Ice is a resource for future explorers
how_it_worked: Landed with thrusters; its arm scooped soil into tiny ovens to sniff the gases

name: InSight lander
discovery: Detected marsquakes and measured the planet's core
earth_benefit: Compares Mars's insides with Earth's
how_it_worked: A robotic arm placed the seismometer on the ground and covered it with a wind shield

name: Ingenuity helicopter
discovery: First powered, controlled flight on another planet
earth_benefit: Opens the sky for exploring other worlds
how_it_worked: Fast-spinning carbon-fibre blades to fly in air about 1% as thick as Earth's; solar-charged

name: Pioneer 10
location: Beyond the planets, heading out of the solar system
discovery: First craft through the asteroid belt and past Jupiter
earth_benefit: Showed the outer solar system could be reached
how_it_worked: Nuclear-powered and spinning for stability, with a big dish pointed at Earth

name: Voyager 1
location: Interstellar space, the most distant human-made object
discovery: First spacecraft to cross into interstellar space
earth_benefit: Shows where the Sun's protective bubble ends
how_it_worked: Nuclear-powered; engineers switch off instruments one by one to save power

name: Voyager 2
discovery: The only spacecraft to visit Uranus and Neptune
earth_benefit: Our only close-up look at the ice giants
how_it_worked: Used the gravity of each planet as a slingshot to reach the next

name: New Horizons
discovery: First close-up of Pluto, including its heart-shaped ice plain
earth_benefit: Small, cold worlds can be geologically alive
how_it_worked: Piano-sized probe that slept for most of its nine-year trip to save wear
